name: Megan Menchaca
text:
As Austin ISD faces a potential takeover, join @texastribune.org in downtown Austin on Oct. 21 for an event all about state takeovers.

I’ll be moderating my first-ever Tribune panel on “State Takeovers: Lessons From Other Districts” starting at 5 p.m.
imageAlt: Event graphic from Texas Tribune Events and Austin Current: "Who controls our schools? Inside Texas' state takeovers," over a chalkboard, books and a backpack.
